skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain basic concepts of multimedia, hypermedia, and use technologies and tools for multimedia data mining on the Internet.
Apply multimedia processing tools for feature extraction, text, audio, image, and video compression tasks.
Construct multimedia databases and understand basic knowledge about virtual reality, visualization systems, and virtual reality software.
Proficiently use tools for internet multimedia data mining.
Proficiently use tools for audio feature extraction, image processing, and audio/image compression.
Demonstrate ability to work independently and in groups, understanding responsibilities and professional ethics.
Follow classroom discipline, participate in discussions, and demonstrate cooperation and personal responsibility.
